## ObsidianQuickLaunch

> Open or create Obsidian vaults from the Windows right-click context menu.

🫶❤️[Support this project](https://ko-fi.com/ScottKirvan) · 📖 [User Guide](https://www.scottkirvan.com/ObsidianQuickLaunch/) · 💬 [Discord](https://discord.gg/TN6XJSNK5Y) · 🐛 [Report a Bug](https://github.com/ScottKirvan/ObsidianQuickLaunch/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) · ✨ [Request Feature](https://github.com/ScottKirvan/ObsidianQuickLaunch/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) · 📋 [Changelog](https://github.com/ScottKirvan/ObsidianQuickLaunch/blob/main/notes/CHANGELOG.md)

---


### ✨ What's New

- Built-in local search is now available across the ObsidianQuickLaunch documentation site, making it easier to find guides and shortcut references directly in your browser.
- Direct links for community channels, documentation, and Ko-Fi support have been added to the header banner on the docs site.

### 🛠 Fixes & Improvements

- Scaled down the documentation site layout and font sizing to provide a cleaner, more compact reading view on desktop displays.
- Added changelog links to release footers so you can view full version details with a single click.

📋 [Changelog](https://github.com/ScottKirvan/ObsidianQuickLaunch/blob/main/notes/CHANGELOG.md)
